title: Common
description: Shared definitions used by every Nomi schema.

ndc11.title: Ndc11
ndc11.description: National Drug Code normalized to 11 digits with no hyphens, e.g. 50580044902.

unii.title: Unii
unii.description: FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier: 10 uppercase letters or digits, e.g. 362O9ITL9D (acetaminophen).

persona.title: Persona
persona.description: Type of person a score is for. The list is owned by docs/scoring/dimensions.md (NOMI-016).

dimension.title: Dimension
dimension.description: Risk dimension every ingredient is rated on. The list is owned by docs/scoring/dimensions.md (NOMI-016).

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: Health condition a user can add to their profile. The list is owned by docs/scoring/dimensions.md (NOMI-016).

medication_type.title: MedicationType
medication_type.description: Type of medication a user already takes. The list is owned by docs/scoring/dimensions.md (NOMI-016).

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: Risk severity of one ingredient on one dimension for one persona: 0 none, 1 low, 2 moderate, 3 high.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: Color band shown with a score.

review_status.title: ReviewStatus
review_status.description: How much human review a value has had.

citation_source.title: CitationSource
citation_source.description: Kind of source a value comes from.

citation.title: Citation
citation.description: Where a value comes from, specific enough that a pharmacist can check it.

document_id.description: Identifier of the document, e.g. an SPL set id, a monograph id, or a DOI.

section.description: Section within the document, e.g. 'Warnings' or 'Table 2'.

quote.description: Short exact quote supporting the value.

citation_id.title: CitationId
citation_id.description: Key into a citations map, e.g. cit_acetaminophen_liver_warning.

citation_map.title: CitationMap
citation_map.description: Citations keyed by citation id, so rows can reference them without repeating them.

provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.description: Which data and code produced a file or record.

schema_version.description: Version of these contracts the data was written with (semver). A major bump means old readers can't read it.

rubric_version.description: Rubric or model version used for scoring, e.g. rubric-v0.1.

code_commit.description: Git commit of the pipeline code.

generated_at.description: When the file or record was produced.
